findings.description: Resource leak & missing teardown: startBiAnalyticsWorker started an untracked hourly setInterval without export of stopBiAnalyticsWorker. Calling it multiple times spawned multiple orphaned intervals with no cleanup on server close.

Event loop pinning & orphaned poll timer: persistentOutboxService was initialized with autoStart: true, running a 100ms setInterval without unref() and without being stopped when Fastify onClose fired or server stopped.
Concurrency race & event loop pin: 30-second setInterval in start() did not call unref(), and checkAndRunJobs() had no concurrency guard, allowing overlapping runs if previous jobs stalled.

Lifecycle shutdown gap: createDenteApiApp did not register onClose hooks for persistentOutboxService, dicomWatcherDaemon, cloudRelayClient, notificationWorker, biAnalyticsWorker, and lanMesh services. Additionally, in startDenteApiServer, taskQueueWorker was not stopped in gracefulShutdown.
Event loop pin in queue worker: setTimeout calls in tick() did not call unref(), pinning the Node event loop unnecessarily when idle.
Background auto-retry poller intervals did not call unref().
